$Comment: A Goblin Feastmaster kill counts as a boss fight, attempted and won, for the player who lands the
killing blow: a quest step, a contract or an achievement counting boss fights counts it, with
Goblin_Feastmaster as the target. The game runs this fight without a boss bar, so the library
keeps no run for it and this row is how it counts.
Match.Role is the role id exactly, case ignored, so a copy of the Feastmaster under another role
id never counts. NameKey names the fight with the game's own name for the creature.
Switch it off with Enabled false, or from mods/ziggfreedcommon/encounter-rules.json under the key
goblin_feastmaster, and the kill counts as a kill and nothing more.
